title: A Visitor for the Well
author: Bram Lockridge
blurb: Tamsin Thornbury, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
